mapper.select: SELECT m.id, m.conversationId FROM ai_message m INNER JOIN ai_conversation c ON c.id = m.conversationId AND c.isDelete = 0 WHERE m.role = 'ASSISTANT' AND m.status = 'PENDING' AND m.isDelete = 0 AND m.createTime < #{expireBefore} ORDER BY m.createTime ASC, m.id ASC LIMIT #{batchSize}
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_message SET content = #{content}, status = 'FAILED', agentErrorKey = #{agentErrorKey}, retryable = 1, updateTime = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{messageId} AND role = 'ASSISTANT' AND status = 'PENDING' AND isDelete = 0 AND createTime < #{expireBefore}
mapper.select: SELECT historyMessage.role,historyMessage.content FROM ai_message historyMessage INNER JOIN (SELECT assistantMessage.requestId, assistantMessage.sequenceNo AS assistantSequenceNo FROM ai_message assistantMessage INNER JOIN ai_message userMessage ON userMessage.conversationId = assistantMessage.conversationId AND userMessage.requestId = assistantMessage.requestId AND userMessage.sequenceNo = assistantMessage.sequenceNo - 1 AND userMessage.role = 'USER' AND userMessage.status = 'SUCCESS' AND userMessage.isDelete = 0 WHERE assistantMessage.conversationId = #{conversationId} AND assistantMessage.role = 'ASSISTANT' AND assistantMessage.status = 'SUCCESS' AND assistantMessage.isDelete = 0 ORDER BY assistantMessage.sequenceNo DESC LIMIT #{turnLimit}) recentTurn ON recentTurn.requestId = historyMessage.requestId AND historyMessage.sequenceNo IN ( recentTurn.assistantSequenceNo - 1, recentTurn.assistantSequenceNo ) WHERE historyMessage.conversationId = #{conversationId} AND historyMessage.role IN ('USER', 'ASSISTANT') AND historyMessage.status = 'SUCCESS' AND historyMessage.isDelete = 0 ORDER BY historyMessage.sequenceNo ASC
